literal_meaning: হাড় এবং নাড়িতে জ্বালানো (burning in the bones and nerves)
figurative_meaning_en: Tormenting or harassing relentlessly from all sides in various ways
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার শাশুড়ি তাকে হাড়ে নাড়ে জ্বালানো করে।
অফিসের বসের কথায় সবাই হাড়ে নাড়ে জ্বালানো অনুভব করে।
example_sentences_in_english: His mother-in-law torments him to his bones and nerves.
Everyone feels tormented to their bones and nerves by the boss's words.
note: This idiom vividly expresses deep emotional or physical irritation, common in colloquial Bengali.
